main_text.p: licet dolor cruciatúsque Dauidis propter pec-catum, deinde confessio peccati coram Deo, postremò peccati remissio. De doloribus Dauidis supra egimus, neque hîc quod iam tractatum est, videtur esse repetendum. Iam ergo sese offert confessio Dauidis nobis explicanda, de qua sic ipse Dauid: Peccatum meum notum tibi feci. Diximus de lucta illa spirituali quæ nobis suscipienda est quoties per pœnitentiam reuocamur à peccato, quan doquidem & mundus & caro & diabolus a-cerrimè pugnant aduersus initia pœniten-Hostes pœnitentiam op-pugnan-tes.tiæ, vt ea siqua fieri possit ratione extinguat. Timor & diffidentia fidem oppugnat, despe-ratio in spem emergentem totis viribus insur-git, vt eam pessundet: Satan autem proponit grauitatem peccati, vim legis horrorémque iudiciorum Dei, quæ omnia adhibet tàquam tormenta bellica quibus peccatorem perter-refactum concutiat ac deiiciat, ne ad miseri-cordiam Dei erigat oculos, sed iaceat in ipsa mortis voragine demersus.Spiritu ale cer- tameo- mnium grauissi- mum.Illud igitur certa-men longè est grauissimū neque satis expêdi, imò ne cogitari quidè potest ab iis qui illud semel non susceperint. Sed quod de Martyri-bus dicit Cyprianus, huc rectè accommodari potest: Deum ipsum qui suos coronat, in suis vincere, in suis triumphare. Itaque vbi cle-mentissimus ille pater fidei vires in animos nostros iniecit & proposito misericordiæ vultu, serenissimum fulgorem conspicien-

page.notes: Marginal notes are split across several lines in the printed margin; each is given once at its first line. The margin note at "Spiritu ale cer-" is hard to read: "cer-" and the following word are uncertain. The signature "c.j." is faint and uncertain. Page is mostly clean; long s transcribed as plain s; s is not used. Text is set in one paragraph continuing from the previous page, since no indent appears on the page.
